messages.subject: Will HBIC and SPBIC be implemented in lavaan in the future? Paper ref. given(Bollen)
parts:
In the paper
"BIC and Alternative Bayesian Information Criteria in the Selection of Structural Equation Models
Kenneth A. Bollen,  Jeffrey J. Harden, Surajit Ray  & Jane Zavisca"
alternate BIC criteria were used(namely HBIC or Haughton's BIC and SPBIC or Scaled Unit Information Prior BIC).
Will these be implemented in the lavaan package in the future?
